text: A steady soft burn of low warm flames around someone, gently rolling, even in volume throughout.
Soft flames burning steadily close by: a warm, low, gentle flutter of fire, calm and constant.
A quiet, continuous bed of warm fire, deep and soft, breathing slowly, even in volume throughout.
A light blizzard wind in the background: cold and airy, gentle and steady, with soft drifting gusts.
Thin icy wind blowing steadily around someone, a soft winter howl with fine snow hissing in it, low in volume.
A mild snowstorm heard from close by: a calm, continuous cold wind, airy and hushed.
A soft, damp, gentle hiss of fine water vapour drifting around someone, hushed and even.
Cool mist hanging in the air: a very faint, wet, airy whisper of tiny droplets, calm and constant.
A quiet bed of fine drifting spray, soft and airy, like fog moving slowly over water.
